pass_rule: PASS only when no mandatory requirement is falsely represented, the document is machine-readable, and no critical unsupported claim is present.
revision_rule: NEEDS REVISION when a mandatory requirement is missing, unclear, unsupported, or the document is not reliably machine-readable.
forbidden_inference: Do not invent years of experience.
Do not convert training/simulations into employment.
Do not claim a tool was used unless supported by evidence.
